name: YouTube Geofind
summary: Finds YouTube videos with embedded location data near a coordinate.
detail: Searches YouTube for videos with embedded GPS coordinates near a specified location. Many phones embed GPS data in videos when location services are on. Useful for finding eyewitness footage from a sp…
howTo: Enter latitude and longitude of the target location
proTip: Use this after a major event to find unfiltered eyewitness footage that hasn't been reported yet.

name: YouTube Metadata
summary: Extracts full metadata from YouTube videos including upload time and description.
detail: Pulls all available metadata from YouTube videos: exact upload timestamp, description, tags, view/like counts, channel info, and thumbnail URLs. The bulk version handles multiple videos at once.
howTo: Paste one or more YouTube video URLs or IDs
proTip: The exact publish time is in UTC — convert to the local time of the uploader's claimed location to check for timezone co…

name: Amnesty Evidence
summary: YouTube metadata extractor from Amnesty International — built for human rights work.
detail: Extracts YouTube video metadata with a focus on preservation for legal and human rights documentation. Shows upload date, channel details, and generates a citation-ready summary.

name: Hadzy YouTube Comment Search
summary: Search all comments on a YouTube video by keyword.
detail: Search through all comments on a YouTube video by keyword. YouTube's native search doesn't search comments — Hadzy fills this gap. Find mentions of specific names, locations, or phrases in comment sec…
howTo: Enter the YouTube video URL or ID
Enter the keyword to search for

name: Camas Reddit Search (Unddit)
summary: Full-text Reddit search with date range and subreddit filters.
detail: Searches Reddit content through the Pushshift API archive. Filters by subreddit, author, date range, score, and keyword. More powerful than Reddit's native search for OSINT purposes.
howTo: Filter by subreddit to narrow scope

name: Reddit User Analyser
summary: Analyzes a Reddit user's full post history — activity, subreddits, and sentiment.
detail: Builds a comprehensive profile of a Reddit user from their public post history. Shows posting activity timeline, most active subreddits, average karma per post, and sentiment analysis. Great for perso…
howTo: Enter the Reddit username (no u/ prefix needed)

name: Reveddit
summary: Reveals Reddit content removed by moderators and auto-moderators.
detail: Shows removed Reddit posts and comments by querying the Pushshift archive against current Reddit data. Content that appears deleted on Reddit is often still in Pushshift and visible here.
howTo: Navigate to reveddit.com/u/username for a user's removed content
Or reveddit.com/r/subreddit for a subreddit's removed posts
proTip: Combine with Unddit (unddit.com) which shows deleted comments inline in threads.

name: Map of Reddit
summary: Visual map of Reddit's subreddit ecosystem based on user overlap.
detail: Interactive visualization of subreddit relationships based on shared users. Subreddits whose users commonly visit each other are placed near each other on the map. Useful for understanding community r…
howTo: Browse the map — zoom into areas of interest
Click a subreddit bubble to see its connections

name: Reddit Investigator
summary: Analyzes a Reddit account for posting patterns and suspicious behavior.
detail: Analyzes a Reddit user's account for behavioral patterns. Reports posting frequency, active hours, karma distribution, most active communities, and flags any suspicious patterns.

name: Recruitin LinkedIn Search
summary: Build Google X-Ray search queries for LinkedIn profiles.
detail: Generates optimized Google queries to search LinkedIn profiles without a LinkedIn account. Enter name, title, company, or location and get a Google query that returns LinkedIn profile results.
howTo: Enter the target criteria: name, job title, company, location
proTip: Google indexes LinkedIn profile snippets — you can read name, title, and company from the search result without clicking…

name: LinkedIn X-Ray Searcher
summary: Dedicated LinkedIn X-Ray search builder.
detail: Generates advanced Google site:linkedin.com search queries. Combine keywords, job titles, companies, and locations. Returns LinkedIn profiles visible to Google without requiring a LinkedIn login.
howTo: Click Search — it opens Google with the constructed query

name: nqntnqnqmb (LinkedIn CLI)
summary: Python CLI for LinkedIn OSINT — profile scraping and search.
detail: Python package for LinkedIn reconnaissance. Search by name, company, or title. Requires a LinkedIn account for authentication but bypasses some of LinkedIn's search restrictions.

name: Discord ID Lookup
summary: Converts a Discord user ID into account details.
detail: Enter a Discord user ID (Snowflake) and retrieve the username, avatar, and account creation date. The creation date is encoded in the Snowflake ID itself and can be calculated offline too.
howTo: Enable Developer Mode in Discord: Settings → Advanced → Developer Mode
proTip: Account creation date from the Snowflake: (ID >> 22) + 1420070400000 gives the Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

name: Discord Hub User Search
summary: Search Discord usernames across indexed servers.
detail: Searches an index of Discord users from servers that have been crawled. Find a username, see which servers they've been observed in, and retrieve their Discord ID.
howTo: Enter the Discord username (without the discriminator if using new usernames)

name: DISBOARD
summary: Public Discord server listing — search servers by topic.
detail: The largest public Discord server directory. Search by keyword, category, or language. Useful for finding servers related to a specific topic, community, or target.
howTo: Search by keyword or browse categories
Filter by language or server size

name: Discord History Tracker
summary: Browser script to archive and search your Discord message history.
detail: Browser-side script that archives all messages in a Discord channel or DM into a local database. Full-text searchable. Does not require a bot or special permissions — runs as the logged-in user.
howTo: Download the tracker script from dht.chylex.com
proTip: Archive channels before you expect them to be deleted — Discord does not preserve deleted messages.

name: Instaloader
summary: Download Instagram posts, stories, highlights, and metadata.
detail: Comprehensive Instagram downloader and metadata extractor. Downloads photos, videos, stories, highlights, and IGTV. Extracts post metadata including timestamps and location tags.
proTip: Use --fast-update flag to only download new content since the last run — good for ongoing monitoring.

name: Osintgram
summary: Interactive Instagram OSINT tool — extracts followers, following, photos, and more.
detail: Interactive CLI tool for Instagram OSINT. Requires your own Instagram credentials for authentication. Commands extract follower/following lists, hashtags used, tagged locations, and photo metadata.
installCommand: git clone https://github.com/Datalux/Osintgram && pip install -r Osintgram/requirements.txt

name: Toutatis
summary: Extracts phone number and email from an Instagram account.
detail: Uses the Instagram API (via your session cookie) to extract the phone number and email associated with a target account. These are only visible if the user has made them public in their profile settin…
howTo: Get your Instagram session ID from browser cookies (Instagram logged in → DevTools → Application → Cookies → sessionid)

name: Instagram User ID Finder
summary: Retrieves the stable numeric Instagram user ID from a username.
detail: The numeric Instagram user ID (e.g., 123456789) is a stable identifier that persists even if the user changes their handle. Extract it for use in API queries and tracking.
